answer_1.quote: IBSEN focuses on the controllable generation of drama scripts in the form of agent dialogues.

answer_2.quote: We use the F1 metric to evaluate the correctness of objective checking: for each objective completion judgment the director agent has made, we compare it with human judgments. ... We use ChatGPT to evaluate and score the storylines from three dimensions: storyline logicality, storyline coherence and character consistency.
